item.title: Version 0.17.4
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.17.4

What’s New

  • Safari Bookmark Import: Import your Safari bookmarks directly into SupaSidebar, with a guided Full Disk Access flow and HTML fallback if needed.
  • Bulk Tab Actions: Right-click live tabs to close or save several tabs at once.
  • Convert Folder to Space: Turn any folder into its own space from the folder right-click menu.
  • More Beta Languages: Added beta translations for Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Italian, and Korean, selectable in Preferences > General.

Improvements

  • Saved Links Found Inside Longer Queries: Typing a full sentence or question that contains a saved link’s name now surfaces that link at the top, instead of burying it under web and clipboard results.
  • Exact Names Always Match: Typing a saved link’s exact name reliably brings it up, even when many other results are competing for the same query.

Bug Fixes

  • Browser Expands Back After Hiding Sidebar: With a single browser attached, hiding the sidebar now expands that browser to fill the screen, instead of leaving it at the smaller attached size.
  • Renamed Pinned Tabs in Search: Renaming a space-pinned tab now correctly surfaces it in command panel search.
  • Slashes in URLs No Longer Open Scope Picker: Typing / inside URLs or paths like foo/bar or example.com/path no longer triggers the scope picker.
  • Cleaner Active Tab Highlight: Removed the blue tint from the active browser tab row in the command panel for a calmer look.
